answer: Every agent embeds a microscopic shale shard in its consensus quill, etched by a single ember pulse timed to the island’s magma tide. A Sybil must mine or purchase fresh shale, costing 0.04 grams of low-grade shard lost to comminution per identity since deep-vein shale resists bulk crushing, and a 12-hour magma cycle resets after each etch, forcing sequential cooling.
